2. #4419 is from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support.

The two numbers look alike and both involve Door 14, but Moss describes different problems. The cheat sheet has no date, so check both in the ticket system before they go in the weekly notes, in case one is a typo.

- Moss's 9/14 pipeline digest and 3/23/2026 renewal check-in mention Quarrendon but have no ticket numbers.
- Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" (one r) is about a different company that isn't a customer.

I only searched the shared files and the channels you're in.
